Goal: I can derive and use A = (1/2)aP using the apothem.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
The apothem a of a regular polygon is the perpendicular distance from its center to a side.

Area of a regular polygon: A = (1/2)aP, where P is the perimeter.

Split the polygon into n triangles from the center. Each has base s and height a, so the total area is n times (1/2)as = (1/2)a(ns) = (1/2)aP. A regular hexagon of side 6 has apothem 3√3 (a 30-60-90 triangle), so A = (1/2)(3√3)(36) = 54√3.
